notes.title: v4.27.81 - realism, price changes
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627688/8ab0b05c41e59d0537977bf4affc0e06eed75f3c.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear space mechanics,[/p][p][/p][p]This improved the realism of the game and changed the prices for some items in the store.[/p][p][/p][p]Now the spaceship arrives with parts, before it arrived without them and this spoiled the immersion in the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Using an item for automatic repair, the parts are replaced with new ones, it is clear that the parts have really been replaced, before the parts remained unrepaired, but the spaceship was considered repaired.[/p][p][/p][p]Added a flight sound, now during the flight the sound of a jetpack is emitted, and when accelerating, the sound increases.[/p][p][/p][p]Changed the prices for mercury, low-quality uranium and brass, now they are cheaper so that it would be more profitable to create items.[/p][p][/p][p]Bug fixes.[/p][p]Bug # 1 - in multiplayer, batteries were copied when charging teleports.[/p][p]Bug # 2 - in multiplayer, stars changed their location depending on the position of the player who entered.[/p][p]Bug #3 - when charging uranium rods, if you disconnect 1 battery, the charging sound still continues.[/p][p][/p][p]Your review can be more powerful than any battery in the ship :)[/p][p][/p][p]Good luck with crafting <3[/p]

notes.title: v4.26.78 - Synchronization, danger zone, repair reward
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627688/bd0ee7ebd19840bb7db21e626dffeafefcf3b8c0.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear space mechanics,[/p][p][/p][p]This update adds synchronization for the multiplayer mode, created spaceships can be sent to the danger zone, the reward for repair has been changed.[/p][p][/p][p]Synchronization in multiplayer worked quite poorly and there could be cases when 1 player decided to create something in the workshop, put brass in the crafter, and the other player's brass remained hanging in the air, now this problem does not exist.[/p][p][/p][p]In a recent update, it became possible to create spaceships and sell them or send them to help squads, now you can send a spaceship to the danger zone in which the spaceship will survive 4-12 rounds (depending on its level), but it alone can bring quite a large amount of resources.[/p][p][/p][p]Bug fixes.[/p][p]Bug#1 - when creating a spaceship, there could be a problem with installing a gold wire.[/p][p]Bug#2 - when creating a spaceship, there could be a problem with installing a solar sail.[/p][p][/p][p]In plans.[/p][p]Realism.[/p][p][/p][p]Your review can be more powerful than any battery in the ship :)[/p][p][/p][p]Good luck with the repair<3[/p]

notes.title: v4.25.76 - Spaceship creation, copper ore, new items
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627688/9055669173236a777a5336f6ce0ca038602c58ca.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear space mechanics,[/p][p][/p][p]In this update, the creation of spaceships has become available.[/p][p]Now you can create spaceships, 12 types of spaceships are available for creation, each spaceship is created from different parts, there are 3 levels of difficulty in creation, the higher the level of difficulty, the more it will cost.[/p][p]The display will show what parts are required for creation, in the room there is a press for creating plates and a parts crafter.[/p][p]There are 3 types of plates: iron, silver and steel. Iron plate is needed in almost all spaceships, steel plate is needed in the creation of combat spaceships, and silver plate is usually used in more complex spaceships.[/p][p]The parts crafter creates parts from iron, copper, silver, steel and gold. There are 10 parts to choose from: drill, engine, antenna, cannon, gold wire, solar sail, spotlight, minigun and copper wire.[/p][p]When you put all the parts and the spaceship is ready, the gate will open, after that choose where to send the spaceship, you can sell it or send it to help the squads.[/p][p][/p][p]Copper ore has been added, copper ore can be smelted in a level 1 smelter, copper is mined less often than iron and silver, but more often than gold.[/p][p]Copper can no longer be created in the crafter or bought in the store.[/p][p]Copper ore, copper and steel can now be picked up using the Item Collector.[/p][p][/p][p]Bug fixes.[/p][p]Bug#1 - Copper was not saved.[/p][p]Bug#2 - Ammo was not created if there was several mercury in the location.[/p][p]Bug#3 - In multiplayer, when charging batteries, they could split in two.[/p][p]Bug#4 - In multiplayer, when creating ammo, the box for ammo could split in two.[/p][p]Bug#5 - Item Collector could turn copper into iron.[/p][p]Bug#6 - Item Collertor had broken sound.[/p][p]Bug#7 - In the tutorial, if you don't close the gate, everything breaks.[/p][p]Bug#8 - In multiplayer, when remelting ores, 5 ingots were created at once.[/p][p][/p][p]In the plans.[/p][p]Improved synchronization between players.[/p][p] The spaceship can be sent to the danger zone.[/p][p][/p][p]Your review can be more powerful than any battery in the ship :)[/p][p][/p][p]Good luck in crafting <3[/p]

notes.title: v4.23.68 - Copper and mining farm improvement
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627688/3c3d4fed0bca6ea852eca4df10d620acb0f837a0.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear space mechanics,[/p][p][/p][p]This update added copper, a way to create copper, and an upgrade for the mining farm.[/p][p]A copper ingot was added, it is an orange ingot that can be sold for 125 coins.[/p][p]Copper can be created in a level 1 crafter from 2 iron ingots and 2 silver ingots.[/p][p]A new upgrade for the mining farm increases the efficiency of the mining farm, meaning that more coins will be given for each unit of energy.[/p][p][/p][p]Bug fixes.[/p][p]Bug#1 - the device for automatic sale was not saved.[/p][p]Bug#2 - automatic sale did not work.[/p][p]Bug#3 - the teleport in the horror location did not work.[/p][p]Bug#4 - tasks in the shopping center did not work.[/p][p]Bug#5 - when flying on a spaceship, the character's camera was not inside.[/p][p][/p][p]In the plans.[/p][p]Custom spaceship creation, create spaceship parts and assemble them piece by piece.[/p][p][/p][p]Your review can be more powerful than any battery in the ship :)[/p][p][/p][p]Good luck with the repair <3[/p]

notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627688/c527586e768ab4d81bcd805388171d96ae560d4c.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear space mechanics,[/p][p][/p][p]In this update, the uranium rod repair system has been reworked and the repair system for the spaceship in the photo has been simplified.[/p][p]Now, in order to repair a uranium rod, you need 2 medium batteries (plus) instead of 4 small batteries (plus).[/p][p]The spaceship in the photo was difficult to repair because the flasks with uranium liquid often flew further than necessary, but from the perspective of the one who was repairing everything looked normal, which could cause confusion for the player and this was very annoying, now this problem will no longer exist.[/p][p][/p][p]Bug fixes.[/p][p]Bug#1 - Uranium could not be created.[/p][p]Bug#2 - Sound settings did not work.[/p][p]Bug#3 - The flame sound of one of the spaceships did not turn off.[/p][p][/p][p]In the plans.[/p][p]Adding copper and crafting from copper.[/p][p][/p][p]Your review can be more powerful than any battery in the ship :)[/p][p][/p][p]Good luck with crafting <3[/p]

notes.title: 35% Discount! Major update!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627688/dcc157dbd9afd6f49fc7e1293a7d77effea5287c.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear Space Mechanics! 🚀[/p][p][/p][p]I am happy to announce our first discount: 35% for only 7 days![/p][p][/p][p]In the 45 days since the game was released, the game has changed a lot compared to the very first version: multiplayer, workshop, improved graphics and physics, optimization and many fixes.[/p][p][/p][p]3 major updates, 16 regular updates were released and 48 bugs were fixed.[/p][p][/p][p]And this is just the beginning! There are many more updates planned.[/p][p][/p][p]Purchase the game with a 35% discount - the offer is valid for 7 days only![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627688/8d9f1d47486e7c8e2a2f6943114bde50072e34f7.png"][/img][/p][p]In this major update, a system for loading saves in multiplayer was added, now when playing with friends you can load a save by pressing the load button, only the owner of the room can load saves, but anyone who is in the room can save.[/p][p][/p][p]Added a conveyor, it can quickly move items from the workshop directly to the sales area, the conveyor needs to be charged with medium batteries with a minus value, after you have charged the conveyor you can use it, move the item you want to move to the conveyor and press the button, after that the item will be moved to the sales area, you can move several items at once.[/p][p][/p][p]Bug fixes.[/p][p]Bug#1 - batteries could not be supplied on the trading platform.[/p][p]Bug#2 - some spaceships did not have sound for the buttons.[/p][p]Bug#3 - target designators were not sold.[/p][p]Bug#4 - the sale of items in multiplayer differed in time for players if they had different FPS.[/p][p]Bug#5 - when crafting rockets, if you immediately pressed the creation button without waiting for the steel to melt, the steel did not disappear.[/p][p]Bug#6 - very often when creating cartridges, even if the mercury fulminate was set correctly, then the creation of cartridges was still not available.[/p][p][/p][p]in the plans.[/p][p]a way to create uranium, brass and steel.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing and supporting the project![/p][p][/p][p]Your review can be more powerful than any battery in the ship :)[/p][p][/p][p]Good luck with the repair <3[/p]

notes.title: v3.16.42 - Saving items, indicator for squads
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627688/4c04ea662b9b008bf6b6bd3d5af8bfbe35fab4bd.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear space mechanics,[/p][p][/p][p]This update adds a system for saving items, now after loading a save a spaceship will fly to you and deliver you saved items.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627688/624837f5845dd241fdda06bc3d1634c2e206c83d.png"][/img][/p][p]According to the advice from the review, indicators for squads have been added, now the type of ore that the squad can find and deliver will be displayed.[/p][p]The system for successful delivery of ores has been changed, previously a squad had to have 500 points for successful delivery, now only 200 are needed, but this did not change the amount of ore delivery.[/p][p][/p][p]Bug fixes.[/p][p]Bug#1 - in multiplayer, when charging teleporters, the battery might not charge the teleporter of the connected player.[/p][p]Bug#2 - when using the save loading, if the squad had several identical spaceships, then only 1 of them was counted.[/p][p]Bug#3 - the twelfth spaceship in the squad table was not deleted when loading a save.[/p][p]in the plans.[/p][p][/p][p]A major update that will allow you to use the save system in multiplayer.[/p][p]A conveyor that allows you to quickly transfer items from the workshop to the sales area.[/p][p][/p][p]Your review can be more powerful than any battery in the ship :)[/p][p][/p][p]Good luck with the repair <3[/p]

notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627688/a80e6a22f766840ae4d8b8bfa2dd4ec2d75fcde6.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear space mechanics,[/p][p][/p][p]This update added a bonus for repairing spaceships,[/p][p]for the first repair of a spaceship you get 1200, this number increases by 100 for each ship.[/p][p][/p][p]Bug fixes.[/p][p]Bug#1 - when re-crafting rockets, mercury might not disappear.[/p][p]Bug#2 - when buying or crafting an item in the marketplace, the lot changed.[/p][p][/p][p]Planned to add.[/p][p]Mercury crafting system.[/p][p][/p][p]Your review may be more powerful than any battery in the ship :)[/p][p][/p][p]Good luck with crafting <3[/p]

notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627688/50d493ebfeae31e00dae50fa6d441fae3bf5680c.png"][/img]Dear space mechanics,[/p][p][/p][p]This update added a trading platform, it is a system through which NPS order items at an inflated price, NPS order a certain number of items and after a short time other NPS, just like you, can sell the items and you need to sell them before other NPS, if you don't have time, then it's okay because another lot will appear.[/p][p][/p][p]A "mein menu" button was added for convenience.[/p][p][/p][p]The floor texture has been changed.[/p][p][/p][p]Bug fixes.[/p][p]Bug #1 - reconnection could cause a network break, due to which multiplayer might not work.[/p][p][/p][p]Your review may be more powerful than any battery in the ship :)[/p][p][/p][p]Good luck with the repair <3[/p]

notes.title: v3.7.23 - optimization and improvement of management
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627688/035178f65681cbbc5701f057dee094161f942e1c.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear space mechanics,[/p][p][/p][p]In this update, the game optimization was improved, earlier, when looking at the spaceship, stars and other locations at the same time, some users could experience a drop in FPS, but now there is no such problem, the picture has become smooth.[/p][p][/p][p]In the last update I promised to make a smooth drop in speed for realism, now the character will not suddenly stop in place, but will float for some time by inertia depending on his speed.[/p][p][/p][p]Due to the fact that the cost of all items has increased by 3 times, now the mining farm produces more money.[/p][p][/p][p]Bug fixes.[/p][p]Bug # 1 - when the spaceship flew away for the second time, the flame did not turn on.[/p][p]Bug # 2 - in multiplayer, players had different amounts of light.[/p][p]In the plans.[/p][p]Trading platform - you will need to quickly create and sell the desired item to get a big profit.[/p][p][/p][p]Your review can be more powerful than any battery in the ship :)[/p][p][/p][p]Good luck in crafting <3[/p]

notes.title: v3.6.18 - Workshop, graphics improvements, bug fixes
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627688/3d110c198af0526cab6c22a0bb3a35c7137a7bcc.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear space mechanics,[/p][p][/p][p]This major update has completely changed the system of repairing spaceships.[/p][p][/p][p]A new room has been added - a workshop, in which you can repair broken parts.[/p][p]There are 5 repair tables in the workshop.[/p][p][/p][p]You can repair a GPS tracker using a laptop.[/p][p]To charge liquid tanks, you need to create liquids using low-quality uranium and batteries and fill empty tanks.[/p][p]To charge batteries, the station's energy is used, to charge a uranium rod, you need 4 small batteries with a plus value.[/p][p]To craft a cartridge, you need brass and mercury fulminate.[/p][p]To craft missiles, you need mercury fulminate, 2 steel ingots and target designators.[/p][p]New ingredients for crafting have been added: mercury fulminate, steel, low-quality uranium and brass.[/p][p][/p][p]You can also now buy broken parts.[/p][p]The price of all serviceable parts has been increased by 3 times, and the profit from sale by 2 times.[/p][p]This opens up a new way to earn money, you can buy a broken part, fix it and sell it.[/p][p]You can also create parts from scratch and sell them.[/p][p][/p][p]Since the parts repair system has now become more complex and interesting, the "experienced mechanic time" has been extended, when the ship was repaired in less than 80 seconds, an additional fee was given for speed, now this time has been extended to 150 seconds.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, when the round ends, parts are not deleted from the location, since they can now be used.[/p][p][/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627688/cd494154e4610ff057a7df2a23bdbf1deda90803.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627688/034064f8c88f801fc84a88b76f26838032839280.png"][/img][/url][/p][p]Graphics improvement - shadows have been added, all objects and even spaceships cast a shadow.[/p][p][/p][p]Bug fixes.[/p][p]Bug #1 - when creating something, all the uranium in the location disappeared and could no longer appear.[/p][p]Bug #2 - you could fly out of the location in the casino and in the shopping center.[/p][p]bug #3 - now you can rotate all objects.[/p][p]bug #4 - touching some triggers in the spaceship you could teleport to different locations.[/p][p]bug #5 - if you click on the gate opening button faster than FPS, you could break the gate.[/p][p]bug #6 - now if 2 players take different items, this will not create problems[/p][p]bug #7 - in multiplayer, the mining farm did not work well, you could split batteries.[/p][p]bug #8 - in multiplayer, the same items could be in different locations.[/p][p][/p][p]Planned to add.[/p][p][/p][p]liquid mixer, you can mix liquids and make more expensive, explosive, strange ones.[/p][p]More realistic control, the player will not just stop in place. but will fly for some time by inertia.[/p]

notes.title: New spaceships repair system
notes.notes: [p]Dear space mechanics,[/p][p]A major update will be released soon, due to the fact that many players say that the spaceship repair system is very simple, I decided to make the repair more interesting.[/p][p]A new room will be added - a workshop, in the workshop you will be able to repair broken parts, this will also add a new way to earn money, you can buy broken parts, repair them and sell them.[/p][p]Because of the new repair system, working parts will cost much more (2-3 times), new items will be added: low-quality uranium, mercury fulminate, brass, target designator and large gas cylinders.[/p][p]You will need to buy light in order to charge batteries and GPS plates.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627688/8de45e1ffe3dce5597e077c85f4be3c426c99826.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: v2.6.8 - Multiplayer, graphics and bug fixes
notes.notes: [p]Finally, less than 2 weeks after the news about multiplayer, multiplayer appeared in the game. Invite your friends and explore the game together.[/p][p][/p][p]The graphics and character control have also been improved, now if you hit a wall, you will simply slow down and thus will not roll over because of each object.[/p][p]Now you will not encounter identical ships several times in a row.[/p][p][/p][p]A large number of very unpleasant bugs have been fixed.[/p][p][/p][p]Bug #1 - The ship with the disk was difficult to fix due to a bug related to the battery trigger.[/p][p]Bug #2 - The container ship was also poorly repaired due to a battery trigger.[/p][p]Bug #3 - the player could accidentally press the button to call the next ship 2 times, which broke the game.[/p][p][/p][p]It is planned: a workshop in which you will repair parts, and not just buy them in a store, because of this there will be increased prices for parts, the "time of an experienced repairman" will be increased due to the fact that you will need to repair parts.[/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback can be more powerful than any battery in the ship :)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627688/e8485f4afb5180cdad467ba6620fd7b2a85e9c58.png"][/img][/p]
